translations.web: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.
translations.bsb: For this is what the Lord says to me: “Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.
translations.kjv: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
